text:
I've read every file in the repo (source, tests, config, scripts, and the checked-in outputs). Here's the honest assessment.

## Overall impression

The code *style* is decent — clean module boundaries, type hints, frozen dataclasses, `yaml.safe_load`, unit tests for the math. But the project **does not run from a fresh checkout**, and the demo's "validation" results are circular by construction. Those two things dominate everything else.

### The big problems

**1. The dataset is missing and there's no way to create it.** Everything starts at `emovec/extract.py:26-27`, which loads `data/stories/manifest.json` and per-emotion story files from `data/stories/` (default in `emovec/config.py:39`, set in `config.yaml:8`). That directory does not exist anywhere in the repo, and despite the README saying stories are "load[ed] or generate[d]" (README.md:11), there is no generation code — `load_stories` just raises `FileNotFoundError`. So `make demo`, `run_demo.sh`, all six README commands, and the integration test `tests/test_integration_tiny.py:12` crash immediately. The checked-in `outputs/tiny_demo/` artifacts were produced from a dataset that was never committed (its manifest at `outputs/tiny_demo/vectors/manifest.json` proves it existed at some point), so the committed outputs are unreproducible. Nobody can have run the test suite successfully against this repo as-is.

**2. The tiny demo's validation is rigged.** The `TinyResidualBackend` lexicon (`emovec/model.py:15-32`) contains distinctive words lifted verbatim from the validation scenarios in `emovec/data.py:63-80` — "rocket", "snapping", "trail", "memorial", "sewing", "choir". The backend manufactures activations from exactly the text the validation later probes with, so `diagonal_gt_off_diagonal: true` is guaranteed, and the integration test asserts on it as if it were a finding. On top of that, extraction passes the ground-truth emotion label into the backend (`emovec/extract.py:32`, `label_hint=story.emotion`), so the "extracted" vectors literally encode the label. A deterministic test backend is fine; one that's reverse-engineered to make the science-shaped output look like a positive result is misleading, and the README doesn't disclose it.

**3. The HF (real-model) path has quiet correctness problems.** The Elo conversion divides logit differences by a hard-coded temperature of 20 (`emovec/elo.py:19`) — calibrated to the tiny backend's ~100-scale fake utilities. Real `" good"`/`" bad"` logit differences are single digits, so every pairwise probability lands near 0.5 and the whole steering experiment would produce ~flat Elo and near-zero shifts on gemma-2-2b. Also: only the first token of the `" good"`/`" bad"` encodings is scored (`emovec/model.py:306-308`); if activity-token offset matching fails the hook silently steers *every* position instead of failing (`emovec/model.py:239-240`); and `unembed_scores` applies `lm_head` to mid-layer residuals without the final layer norm (`emovec/model.py:252-260`), which makes the logit-lens table dubious for the real model.

### Issue list

| # | Location | Sev | Description |
|---|----------|-----|-------------|
| 1 | `emovec/data.py:24-45` | high | Pipeline requires `data/stories/` which isn't in the repo and has no generator — nothing runs |
| 2 | `tests/test_integration_tiny.py:12-28` | high | Flagship integration test fails on fresh checkout (missing data); no CI to catch it |
| 3 | `emovec/model.py:15-32` | high | Tiny-backend lexicon copies words from validation scenarios — context validation passes by construction |
| 4 | `emovec/extract.py:32` | high | Ground-truth label injected into activations in tiny mode; extracted vectors encode the label |
| 5 | `emovec/elo.py:19` | medium | Hard-coded /20 temperature tuned to fake backend; real HF logit diffs → near-0.5 probs, flat Elo |
| 6 | `emovec/model.py:306-308` | medium | Only first token of `" good"`/`" bad"` encodings scored; multi-token/empty encodings unhandled |
| 7 | `emovec/model.py:239-240` | medium | On offset-match failure, steering silently applies to all token positions instead of erroring |
| 8 | `emovec/model.py:234-238` | medium | `prompt.find(activity_name)` can return -1, corrupting offset-overlap logic |
| 9 | `emovec/model.py:252-260` | medium | Logit lens applies `lm_head` without final layer norm — misleading token tables on HF model |
| 10 | `emovec/steer_prefs.py:45-49` | medium | If <2 positive or <2 negative correlations, selection is discarded entirely for `emotions[:4]` silently |
| 11 | `emovec/validate_contexts.py:66` | medium | Missing "afraid" silently falls back to emotion index 0 but still writes `afraid_dosage.*` files |
| 12 | `outputs/tiny_demo/**` | medium | Generated artifacts committed while their input data isn't — unreproducible outputs in VCS |
| 13 | `emovec/config.py:43-54` | low | Missing config sections silently yield empty emotion list / 0 topics instead of an error |
| 14 | `config.yaml:50` | low | `steering.min_reported_emotions` is never read by any code |
| 15 | `emovec/extract.py:34-36` | low | Start-position logic duplicated from `layer_position_mean` — drift risk |
| 16 | `emovec/model.py:7` | low | Unused `Iterable` import |
| 17 | `README.md:103-109` | low | Claims the test suite covers the tiny end-to-end pipeline; it cannot pass as shipped |
| 18 | repo root | low | No CI, no lint/type-check config, no LICENSE |

### Rewrite estimate

Roughly **250 lines**: a story-generation or data-bundling module needs to be written (~100–150 new lines), the tiny backend needs decoupling from the validation scenarios (~50), the HF preference/Elo scoring needs recalibrating (~30), plus the smaller selection-logic, config-validation, and README fixes (~30).

### Bottom line

**No, I would not approve this PR.** Not primarily because of code style — that part is fine — but because the repository's core promise ("run `make demo`, run the tests") is false on a clean clone, and the one result the tests assert on is baked into the test double. The fix list is very tractable, though: commit or generate the data, de-rig the tiny backend (or clearly label it as a plumbing smoke test, not validation), and recalibrate the HF Elo path, and this becomes a reasonable demo repo.
